name: The Rednecks
caption: A team name held across two distinct pairings — DJ Finch and Tony Lozon won the WWE Chaos Tag Team Championship under the name once, and DJ Finch and Brandon Walsh won it again as "The Rednecks" a second time, the pairing still champion as of the fed's own 5 January 2005 broadcast.
notes: Membership changed at least once: DJ Finch and Tony Lozon are credited together as "The Rednecks" on the fed's own Title History page's sixth tag reign; DJ Finch and Brandon Walsh are credited together under the same name on its tenth and last-recorded tag reign, and the fed's own 5 January 2005 broadcast independently confirms Brandon Walsh as "1/2 of the Chaos Tag Team Champions" at that date.
